content: Google DeepMind has released Gemma 4, their latest open-source AI model. The model achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks while being significantly smaller than competitors. Available in two variants: e2 (2B) and e4 (4B parameters).
Google DeepMind releases Gemma 4 open source AI model with SOTA benchmark results. Two variants available: e2 and e4. Outperforms previous generation.
